dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple O-shaped structures with jagged, high-contrast light-grey perimeters enclosing dark centers; perimeters exhibit sharp pixel-intensity gradients from the dark pelt to the light ring boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, high-intensity white speckles lacking internal gradients, concentrated primarily in the anterior neck region and the ventral-lateral interface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A central triad of prominent O-rings forms an obtuse scalene triangle in the mid-lateral zone; two vertically aligned rings are positioned posterior to the primary cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct regional transition from a fine-grained, micro-speckled texture on the head and neck to a discrete, large-scale annular pattern across the mid-body.
